question.text:
Given that $E_{\mathrm{O}_2 / \mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{O}}^{\circ}=+1.23 \mathrm{~V}$;
$\begin{aligned}
& E_{\mathrm{S}_2 \mathrm{O}_8^{2-} / \mathrm{SO}_4^{2-}}^{\circ}=2.05 \mathrm{~V} ; E_{\mathrm{Br}_2 / \mathrm{Br}^{-}}^{\circ}=+1.09 \mathrm{~V} \\
& E_{\mathrm{Au}^{3+} / \mathrm{Au}}^{\circ}=+1.4 \mathrm{~V}
\end{aligned}$
The strongest oxidising agent is :

solution.text: Reduction potential is maximum for $\mathrm{S}_2 \mathrm{O}_8{ }^{2-}$ therefore, it is the strongest oxidising agent amongst the given species.
